name: The Black Widow
description: §2,000 and a silver tongue. Marry three different sims, outlive each one, and end up with §100,000 in funds and inheritance. The marriages are ticked by hand as you go.

goals.description: Marry the first sim (tick when the wedding is over)
Marry a second, different sim (tick when the wedding is over)
Marry a third, different sim (tick when the wedding is over)

win.notification: Three spouses, three inheritances. You did it beautifully.

lose.notification: The money ran out before the next ring.
